tasks.instruction:
Complete the text using suitable words.
Dowry means property or money brought (a) ____ a bride to her husband. During marriage ceremony, (b) ____ section of greedy people (c) ____ much wealth or money (d) ____ the guardians of the brides. (e) ____ poor illiterate girls become the victims (f) ____ dowry. If the guardians fail to fulfil the (g) ____ of the bridegroom, the brides are maltreated. So, the poor cannot think (h) ____ marriage of their daughters. It is a (i) ____ curse. This curse can be eliminated by changing the outlook of people (j) ____ the male members.
tasks.answer: (a) by; (b) a; (c) demand; (d) from; (e) The; (f) of; (g) demands; (h) of; (i) social; (j) especially

tasks.instruction:
Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the verbs given in the brackets.
The secret of success in life (a) ____ (lie) in the proper use of time. Many of us (b) ____ (forget) that every moment is valuable. We do not know when we (c) ____ (die). If we do (d) ____ (make) the proper use of time, we cannot discharge our duties in time. Time once (e) ____ (lose) cannot be regained.
tasks.answer: (a) lies; (b) forget; (c) will die; (d) not make; (e) lost

tasks.instruction:
Rewrite the following passage in the reported speech.
Returning home, my mother said to me, "Your progress in studies is very slow. You always move about with a group of your friends. Aren't you idling away your time with them? Can't you be more serious?" "I'm sorry and I will amend myself," I replied.
tasks.answer: Returning home, my mother told me that my progress in studies was very slow and that I always moved about with a group of my friends. She asked whether I was not idling away my time with them and whether I could not be more serious. I replied that I was sorry and would amend myself.

tasks.instruction: Change the following sentences as directed in the brackets.

subitems.text: Very few insects are as busy as a bee. (Comparative)
subitems.answer: A bee is busier than most other insects.

subitems.text: It flies from flower to flower and collects honey. (Interrogative)
subitems.answer: Doesn't it fly from flower to flower and collect honey?

subitems.text: It stores honey in the hive. (Passive)
subitems.answer: Honey is stored in the hive by it.

subitems.text: It leads a very disciplined life. (Exclamatory)
subitems.answer: What a disciplined life it leads!

tasks.instruction:

tasks.answer: The old man said, "Can you give me some food? I've been starving for two days." The maid said, "Why do you beg? Can't you work?"
